_note: Terraria-Lite track. Entries with a 'ref' take their numbers from generated files: 'rl:final/<key>' and 'rl:run/<id>' from data/rl.json, 'llm:<study>/<harness>' from data/llm.json. v9 and v10 entries carry their numbers inline with a 'source' (eg15 run summaries or a report); 'score.ci_kind: range' means the interval is the min to max over seeds or worlds, not a confidence interval. Entries with placeholder: true are invented to show the layout.

contract.summary: RL and LLM agents get the same symbolic observation (11x9 local tile, light and entity window, inventory, status, earned achievements), the same legal-action mask and the same scorer. LLMs additionally receive the public rules and recipes as text.
contract.observation: 11x9 local view: tile ids, light, visible mobs; inventory (sqrt(count/999) encoding), equipment, cooldowns, achievement bits. Darkness hides terrain and mobs.
contract.actions: 83 discrete primitive actions (move, jump, mine/place in 20 reach cells, craft each recipe, select, attack, heal, climb). Masks encode physical legality, not strategy.
contract.horizon: 3,000 primitive actions per episode (v7/v8); 10,000 in v9 and v10 (v10: 15 game ticks per action, 41.7 game minutes).
contract.score_v8: Achievements unlocked, out of 32 (equal weight). IQM over training seeds with a bootstrap 95% CI.
contract.score_v9: Percent of the maximum weighted score (tiers weighted 1/3/5/8; max 129 on v9, 145 on v10), mean over episodes. IQM over 5 seeds with a bootstrap 95% CI where 5 seeds exist; otherwise the mean with the range over seeds.
contract.llm_rules: Primitive or open-loop lists of up to 16 primitive actions per call; every action costs a tick; illegal actions still cost a tick; no tools, code execution, map or hidden state; notes and history are declared scaffold settings.

versions.label: v10 (real-Terraria ports)
versions.status: Release candidate (DECISIONS.md B1, recommended, 2026-11-08): v9 plus behaviour ports from Terraria's source (mob AI, combat, physics, mining, trees) at 15 game ticks per action, and two tier-4 stepping stones (find a Demon Altar, hold 6 lenses). 40 achievements, weighted maximum 145. PPO pilots on the 128 validation worlds 23,000,001 to 23,000,128; no reserved test-world evaluation and no LLM runs on v10 yet.

versions.label: v9
versions.status: Layered 128x128 world, day and night, Zombies, Demon Eyes, Skeletons and the Eye of Cthulhu; 38 achievements in four tiers, weighted maximum 129. PPO pilots (validation worlds) and an LLM campaign (public worlds) ran on 2026-11-08. Generic PPO scores about 56% at 1B steps, above the 25 to 35% target band, so v10 replaced v9 as the release candidate.

versions.label: v8 (ore 3x, trees 2x)
versions.status: Development preview used for the October 31 to November 3 PPO studies. Reserved test worlds 25,000,001 to 25,000,128 evaluated once per final configuration.

versions.label: v7 (= v8 default knobs)
versions.status: Frozen v7 core. The LLM harness studies ran here; the viz page's wasm build is byte-identical to it.

v10_ablations._note: Generic PPO arm (gamma .9999, 1B steps) on v10 builds that switch the five behaviour ports (FID_MOBS, FID_COMBAT, FID_PHYSICS, FID_MINING, FID_TREES) on or off; every build runs 15 game ticks per action. 'One port off' turns one port off and keeps the rest on; 'one port on' turns every other port off, trees included. Scores are final weighted % on the 128 validation worlds per seed; counts (anvil, return to surface, lens, altar) are worlds out of 128 per seed; deaths are the mean share of episodes. The night-tuning builds are the open decision DECISIONS.md B4.
